sources.actual_read_extent: Read the complete relevant sections in the full CMI-hosted 139-page PDF: §3 on quantum fields and Wightman/Osterwalder–Schrader axioms; §4 on the exact problem, field content, short-distance requirements and spectral mass-gap definition; §5 on confinement as a separate extension; and §6 on lower-dimensional, compact-volume, finite-volume-gap and infinite-volume limitations.
sources.limitations: Supports the formulation, definitions, and qualified partial-status discussion. It is not a proof of the open problem, and its compact or lower-dimensional results are not promoted to the required continuum theory on R^4.
